craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of practiced freedom — fire-and-freedom song, practice to vision. Fire swallows; when-that-then-that kept stammering; all-devouring close. Rejected: (a) smoothing stammer → killed: stammer is the fire-tongue. Read aloud: KNOW-ing-FIRE SWAL-lows-THAT … FIRE all-de-VOUR-ing.

lines: Knowing-fire swallows that — this, well awake, it is;
when that, then that, pure, to-be-known — fire all-devouring.

reads_against.argmap: What does the fire swallow? → Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
c1_essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.
